research_question: Can a simple accumulation-based compatibility model predict the relative numerical Q.ANT error of unseen hierarchical g4 architectures before they are trained?
hypothesis: A model using stage-1 and stage-2 accumulated term counts can predict the ordering and approximate scale of end-to-end Q.ANT numerical discrepancy for held-out hierarchical topologies better than either stage term count alone.
falsification_criterion: The hypothesis is weakened if the combined model fails to improve held-out ranking/absolute prediction over single-stage baselines or predicts the wrong low-error region.

proposed_method.training_data: Exp025 stage-local summaries plus Exp021 accumulation scaling exponent as a prior candidate feature transform

limitations: The calibration set is very small, so this is a proof-of-concept predictive test rather than a general model.
CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
